source: OpenStreetMap via Waymarked Trails hiking API
sourceType: OSM-derived route-relation database, not independently field-verified routes
regionCountsOverlap: A route crossing destination boundaries may occur in multiple regional counts; global routeCount is deduplicated by OSM relation id.

boundaryFilterSource.usage: Existing project boundary geometries used only as a geographic inclusion filter.
boundaryFilterSource.boundaryLicense: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

conversion: Waymarked EPSG:3857 way segments reprojected to WGS84 and rounded to 7 decimals; no simplification, stitching, gap filling or generated geometry.
geometryLengthMeaning: Sum of distinct preserved segments, including branches; not official route distance or recommended itinerary length.

sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.name: Itärajan retkeilyreitti
sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.finding: The operator describes a trail in Kainuu/Suomussalmi connecting Martinselkonen and Hossa. It is not a Russian Karelia route.
sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.sourceScope: Geographic identity only; the older page is not used as a current operating-status confirmation.

sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.name: Vienan reitti
sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.finding: The route operator identifies this as a 27 km trail in Suomussalmi, Finland. A historical connection with Viena does not place the contemporary track in Russian Karelia.
sourceBackedGeographicExclusions.sourceScope: Geographic identity and operator description; no navigation or access certification.

limitations: Finite bounding-box snapshot with API and request caps; no claim of exhaustive trail coverage.
Geographic inclusion is intersection with the existing project destination geometry. Whole original relations can extend beyond a destination.
A route relation can be branched, disconnected, outdated or mapped incompletely.
Difficulty, current access, closures, permits and guide qualification are not established by this import.
Public profile, booking, chat and verified-rating data are not supplied by these map databases.
